p: Clapham High Street is one of South London's busiest nights out, lined with bars, restaurants and late-night food, and MERKUR at number 97 fits right into that round-the-clock buzz. Clapham North and Clapham Common on the Northern line and Clapham High Street on the Overground are all a short walk, so getting here is easy. It's strictly 18+.
By day, Clapham Common is the big draw, with acres of open grass, ponds and a bandstand. Venn Street, near Clapham Common station, has a market and plenty of cafés for a lazy brunch.
